commits.title: One short-memory helper, which shares a read in flight

changes.how: Server-only, no other import. Move from src/server/redirect-live.ts (lines 186 to 204) the Map 'memory', MEMORY_MS, MEMORY_MAX, remembered() and forgetRemembered(), and add in-flight sharing: a second Map<string, Promise<unknown>> 'loading'. remembered(key, load, ms = MEMORY_MS): if a fresh value is in memory return it; else if loading has the key return that promise; else start const run = load().then((value) => { if (memory.size >= MEMORY_MAX) memory.clear(); memory.set(key, { at: Date.now(), value }); return value; }).finally(() => loading.delete(key)); loading.set(key, run); return run. A rejected load is not remembered and leaves loading (the finally). forgetRemembered(key) deletes from memory AND from loading, so a read that started before a change is not handed to a caller after it. Export also forgetWhere(match: (key: string) => boolean) only if redirect-live.ts clears by prefix today (read its forget function below line 204 and keep its behaviour).

Unit tests: 20 concurrent remembered('k', load) calls run load once and all get its value; a second call within ms does not run it; after ms it runs again (vi.useFakeTimers); a load that rejects rejects all waiting callers, is not remembered, and the next call runs load again; forgetRemembered('k') during a load makes the next call start a new load.

Delete the moved lines and add: import { forgetRemembered, remembered, MEMORY_MS } from './short-memory'; export { forgetRemembered, remembered, MEMORY_MS } from './short-memory'; The file's own uses and every importer keep working. Delete the private copy at lines 62 to 71 (MEMO_MS stays as a const, the Map 'memo' and the local remembered() go) and import remembered and forgetRemembered from './short-memory'. Its two callers change argument order to the shared helper's (key, load, ms): remembered('running:' + storeId, async () => {...}, MEMO_MS) and remembered('store:' + slug, async () => {...}, 60_000). forgetRunning(storeId) becomes forgetRemembered('running:' + storeId). (These three functions move to a leaf in the next commit; do the helper change first so the move is a pure move.)

holdingFor() (lines 17 to 36) keeps its own Map with a 30-second life and a 5,000 cap; replace it by remembered('holding:' + apex, async () => {...the read and holdingAnswer(...)...}, MEMO_MS) from './short-memory', and replace the 'memo.delete(name)' at about line 50 in setHolding() by forgetRemembered('holding:' + name).
